comment: Contracts owned by mqobsidian and vendored here so an installed mq-agent needs no vault checkout. The vendored copy must match canonical exactly; scripts/check-vendored-contracts.py proves it in CI. Adding a contract is one entry here, not new code. Filenames differ between the repos on purpose: the vendored names are what the wheel and the runtime already look up, and renaming them is a packaging change that does not belong in a contract change.
